capabilities: render interactive maps with markers, tracks, and overlays from notes
import GPX, GeoJSON, CSV, and polyline overlay data
query vault notes as map data sources via VaultQuery or Dataview
display elevation, speed, and pace charts for tracks
extras: Map rendering requires installing at least one companion provider plugin; the README lists a capability table of provider plugins and offers a sandbox to try it. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize geographic data such as GPX tracks or POI lists on a map inside notes.

relations.evidence: VaultQuery | SQL queries over vault notes as a map data source
Dataview | Dataview queries as a map data source

requires.name: a map-capable provider plugin (e.g. places-leaflet, places-mapbox)
VaultQuery or Dataview for query-based data sources

summary: Maps plugin that renders points of interest, GPX and GeoJSON data from notes on interactive maps with overlays, heatmaps, and charts.
